limitations: Clock-only observations are n1 and separate from instrumented n3; never pool or infer a fixed instrumentation correction. First-on/regeneration regressions remain explicit.
The n3 primary baseline and final were measured in different user-confirmed quiet windows. Same observer/source fingerprints do not eliminate temporal/cache/host variation.
Controls have one fresh fixture each and one off/reactivation cycle; matched comparisons above use final sample1, not the3cycle median. Fixed order remains a confound.
All timings await whole Core API calls; setup and independent Git proofs are outside API clocks. ChildGit/filesystem/method/RSS counts are NOT_MEASURED in clock-only data, represented by null.

Known JS API journal bytes are not physical IO or total copy traffic. fs.copyFile returns void; Git extraction bypasses JS IO counters. Sync duration is summed awaited latency; inclusive phases overlap.
Endpoint file-data allocation uses Stats.blocks*512 with identity deduplication; excludes MFT,directories,ADS,uniqueCoW,deviceIO and peak usage.
No actual process identifiers,private host paths,profiles or raw logs are included. Private unmodified artifacts are identified by exact hashes.
Final functional/broad validation is independent and still required before certification/publication.
